title: Half Term News
summary: Fireworks tickets and volunteering, Christmas dates, pre-loved uniform and our fundraising update.

sections.title: Dear Parents, Carers and Teachers,
paragraphs: With the two-week half term break just around the corner, we hope you all enjoy some lovely time together! There’s plenty to look forward to when we’re back, so here’s a quick round-up from The Friends of Ashley (FOA), with dates for your diary and ways to lend a hand.

sections.title: 🎆 Fireworks on the Field: Thursday 5th November
paragraphs: Join us on the Ashley School field for fireworks, food and family fun! **Gates open at 4:30pm**, with the **quiet display at 5pm** and the **main display at 6pm**. The evening finishes at 6:30pm.

Tickets are **£8.50 per person, with under-2s free**, and have **now gone on sale to the wider public**. If you’re planning to come but haven’t bought your tickets yet, **don’t delay!** The event usually sells out in advance and is now on public sale.

**Could you lend a hand?** From token presales to the prize table, bar and entrance, our volunteers make the evening possible. Please check the rota for your year group and choose a slot using the [volunteer sign-up links](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/fireworks-volunteering/). Thank you!

sections.title: 🎄 Christmas Fayre: Saturday 5th December
paragraphs: Save the date for our festive get-together at Ashley School!

Rachel Briscoe (Squirrel and Otter) and Sophie Glass (Fox) are gathering helpers for the Fun Zone, Craft Room, Café, Photo Booth, Tombola, Entrance & Tokens and Glitter Tattoos. **You can help in any area, bring a friend and no experience is needed.**
[Find out how to help](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/events/christmas-fayre-2026/), or speak to the organisers in the playground.

sections.title: 🎅 Santa’s Grotto: Monday 14th December
paragraphs: A little Christmas magic is coming to Ashley during the school day, with our parent and carer volunteers helping to make it happen. **Please keep it a surprise for the children!**

sections.title: 👕 Pre-loved Uniform: Friday 6th November
paragraphs: Our next sale is **3:25pm to 3:45pm in the school playground**, subject to weather. Coats and new-logo items are **£3**, with all other items **£1**. **Card payments only, please.**
Pick up a bargain, give uniform a second life and support the school. For more information, head over to [uniform information and requests](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/uniform/).

sections.title: 💚 £1,457 raised so far!
paragraphs: Thanks to your support, we’ve raised **£1,457 this school year** through uniform sales, Happy Bags and Art Projects for Schools. That’s a lovely start towards our **£25,000 target**!

sections.title: 📱 Your handy home for The FOA
paragraphs: Forgotten an event date or looking for a volunteer link? Our website brings together **what’s on, tickets, volunteering, pre-loved uniform, newsletters and fundraising updates**.
Please bookmark it for the next time you need a quick answer: [www.thefriendsofashley.org](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/)
closing: Thank you for everything you do to support our school community.
